help.name: Tri-Valley Career Center
help.what: Free one-on-one career coaching, job search workshops, and connections to short-term training and training scholarships. Part of America's Job Center of California, run by Chabot-Las Positas Community College District for the Alameda County Workforce Development Board.

help.name: California Training Benefits (EDD)
help.what: Lets you keep getting unemployment while you're in approved training, without having to look for work. Ask EDD before your 16th week of benefits to qualify for extra weeks. EDD does not pay tuition.
help.where: Online or at any America's Job Center

help.name: California College Promise Grant
help.what: Waives community college enrollment fees for California residents who qualify by income or who receive certain benefits.
help.where: Apply through the Las Positas financial aid office

help.name: Las Positas College Continuing Education
help.what: Tuition-free noncredit certificates in customer service, small business, automotive and more. Some classes have a materials fee.

zones.1: Little or no preparation (a few days to a few months of on-the-job training)
zones.2: Some preparation (usually a high school diploma, a few months to a year of training)
zones.3: Medium preparation (usually vocational school, an associate degree, or an apprenticeship)
